summary.en: The Philippine Coast Guard has contained an oil spill off Mariveles, Bataan, removing 800 kg of oil-contaminated debris, while the Philippine Navy is probing a reservist for an inciting social-media post in Manila. China has deployed more than 100 warships and coast guard vessels across the western Pacific and sent a survey vessel with unidentified equipment into Scarborough Shoal, raising maritime tension. The Department of Environment and Natural Resources ordered immediate assessment and containment of the Mariveles spill, coordinating with the Coast Guard and local governments. 176 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
